celulas_madre.title: Mesenchymal Stem Cells
celulas_madre.description: Totipotent cells capable of converting diseased tissue into healthy tissue. Can be autologous or allogeneic

exosomas.title: Exosomes
exosomas.description: Vesicles extracted from mesenchymal stem cells containing microRNA, proteins and growth factors

prp.title: Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP)
prp.description: Plasma fraction extracted from autologous blood with higher platelet concentration and high levels of growth factors

acido_hialuronico.title: Hyaluronic Acid
acido_hialuronico.description: Joint lubricant that accelerates healing, promotes natural collagen production and has analgesic effects

hero.description: In our Physical Medicine and Sports clinic, we understand that pain or injury affects more than just the body. It can also limit your routine, physical performance, and daily well-being.

what_is.title: What is Physiotherapy?
what_is.text: Physiotherapy is the science of movement. It is a health discipline dedicated to restoring physical function and quality of life through natural and scientific methods. We don't just treat pain; we rehabilitate the body to function at its full potential, using manual techniques, therapeutic exercise, and advanced technology.
what_is.highlight: In our clinic, physiotherapy is directly integrated with Sports Medicine, ensuring that every exercise has a clear biological purpose behind it.

steps.title: Initial Medical Assessment
steps.desc: Dr. James Madrid performs a precise medical diagnosis to identify the biological cause of your pain or limitation.

steps.title: Personalized Program
steps.desc: We define clear goals and design a treatment plan that adapts to your pace and lifestyle.

steps.title: Dynamic Rehabilitation
steps.desc: We combine manual therapy with motor control exercises to recover strength and mobility safely.

steps.title: Prevention and Return
steps.desc: We provide you with the necessary tools to avoid relapses and for you to return to your physical activity with total confidence.

physiological_benefits.title: Real Physiological Benefit
physiological_benefits.intro: Our physiotherapy generates real changes in your biology to accelerate healing:

items.d: Stimulates the production of collagen and fibroblasts to heal damaged tissues.
Regulates neurological receptors to decrease the perception of pain without medication.
Optimizes blood and lymphatic flow, reducing persistent edema and inflammation.
Improves communication between brain and muscle, optimizing every movement.

benefits: Elimination of pain points and chronic contractures
Notable increase in range of motion and flexibility
Better performance in your sports practice
Correction of postural habits that cause fatigue
Prevention of future surgeries through strengthening
Greater independence in your daily activities
content.when_to_consult_intro: Your body sends alert signals. If you experience any of these cases, we are your solution:
when_to_consult: Pain that does not subside after rest (back, neck, knees)
Morning stiffness or difficulty stretching correctly
Recent or chronic sports injuries (sprains, tendinitis)
Excessive muscle fatigue after slight efforts
content.when_to_consult_conclusion: Don't wait for a tweak to become a limiting injury. Timely intervention is key.

symptoms.title: Common Symptoms
symptoms.subtitle: Do you identify any of these signals in your body?

items.title: Lower Back and Neck Pain
items.desc: Persistent discomfort in the back or neck that limits your rest and productivity.

items.title: Joint Stiffness
items.desc: A 'stuck' sensation or difficulty starting movement after being at rest.

items.title: Muscle Weakness
items.desc: Lack of strength or premature fatigue when performing activities that were previously easy.

items.title: Loss of Mobility
items.desc: Inability to reach full range of motion in shoulders, knees, or hips.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions - Physiotherapy
faqs.subtitle: We solve your doubts about our service

items.q: What is the difference between your physiotherapy and conventional ones?
items.a: Our approach integrates sports medicine and specialized physiotherapy. Each patient receives an initial medical assessment, which allows the therapist to work on an already established medical diagnosis, accelerating results.

items.q: How many sessions will I need?
items.a: The number of sessions varies according to the injury and the response of each body. After the initial assessment, we define a plan that usually ranges between 5 and 10 sessions with very clear recovery objectives.

items.q: Do you treat specific sports injuries?
items.a: Yes, we specialize in sports injuries such as sprains, tendinitis, muscle tears and post-surgical rehabilitation, focusing on a safe return to physical activity.

items.q: Do I need a medical order to attend?
items.a: It is not essential to bring an external order, as we ourselves perform the initial sports medical assessment to guarantee safe and effective treatment.
